nodes.label: Prevent Deadlocks with Consistent Lock Ordering
nodes.rationale: Impact MEDIUM-HIGH. Deadlocks arise when two transactions take the same rows in opposite order; acquiring them up front with SELECT ... WHERE id IN (...) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE, or doing the whole change in one CASE-based UPDATE statement, makes the order deterministic. Observability: pg_stat_database.deadlocks, log_lock_waits, deadlock_timeout.
